thesis: Swords to Plowshares remains the benchmark creature answer because one white mana exiles nearly any creature, while the life payment usually matters less than preventing recursion, death triggers, or combat damage.

playbook.role: Use it before the creature generates irreversible value, but wait when combat or a pump spell can improve the exchange. Targeting your own creature is a legitimate emergency line when the life swing matters more than board presence.
